title: Pocketwire Business Tier Ladder: Entry and Retention Volumes
content:
Each tier of the Pocketwire Business Profile has an entry volume, a retention volume and a number of grace months. Volumes are the previous calendar month's net sales volume in US dollars. Column headings abbreviate the six tiers of the Pocketwire Business Profile: Pocketwire Business Starter, Pocketwire Business Essentials, Pocketwire Business Growth, Pocketwire Business Pro, Pocketwire Business Premier and Pocketwire Business Enterprise.

| | Starter | Essentials | Growth | Pro | Premier | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Entry volume (previous month's net sales at least) | USD 0.00 | USD 3000.00 | USD 10000.00 | USD 50000.00 | USD 100000.00 | USD 250000.00 |
| Further entry condition | owner's personal account on Pocketwire Core or a higher plan | none | none | none | none | profile opened at least 12 calendar months before the review |
| Retention volume needed to keep the tier at the monthly review | USD 0.00 | USD 2500.00 | USD 8500.00 | USD 42500.00 | USD 85000.00 | USD 212500.00 |
| Grace months (consecutive monthly reviews below retention volume tolerated before a downgrade) | 0 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 |

## Points of reading

- Entry and retention are different figures. On Pocketwire Business Growth, entry needs USD 10000.00 but keeping the tier needs USD 8500.00.
- "At least" includes the figure itself: a volume of exactly USD 50000.00 meets the Pocketwire Business Pro entry volume.
- Pocketwire Business Enterprise carries two entry conditions, the volume of USD 250000.00 and the profile age of 12 calendar months; both must hold.
- Pocketwire Business Starter is the tier every profile opens on; its retention volume is USD 0.00 and it has no grace months.
